//: The Lighthouse runner is the one ESM entry (.mts → scripts/lighthouse-runner.mjs). ESM emit needs NodeNext resolution (explicit ./lib.js import specifiers), unlike the rest of the engine which is classic CommonJS/Node. This config TYPECHECKS lighthouse (noEmit, inherited); tsconfig.lighthouse.build.json emits it. `npm run typecheck` runs this after the main typecheck; the main tsconfig.json excludes src/runners/lighthouse/** so it never sees the .mjs specifiers.
